selected_target.name: exact tile-K-row BF16 activation AoSoA
selected_target.reason: Every production Q5 consumer still issues one scalar global BF16 activation load per logical output row at each lane/K iteration. The two 35-call rowbatch8/10 roles alone own 346.501 ms, while current weight layouts and arithmetic are already independently qualified.
selected_target.candidate_layout: For each unchanged row group, copy input BF16 bits into [row_group][k][row_slot], padding row slots to 8 or 16 only to align each K record. Consumers read only live BF16 values through width-matched aligned records: b64 for rowbatch4, b64+u16 for rowbatch5, b128 for rowbatch8, b128+b32 for rowbatch10, and b128+b64 for rowbatch12.
selected_target.candidate_producer: A separately registered linear exact BF16-bit pack writes the projection-local activation plane. The first screen includes its launch and bytes; producer fusion is not presumed and may be attempted only with the unfused primitive retained as fallback.
selected_target.candidate_consumer: Reuse each role's current H5X tile-K-col or H5L row-major F32 weight plane, local128/four-wave K ownership, accumulator geometry, scalar fmaf order, wave32 tree, serial wave sum, and output store; only activation addresses/load width change.
selected_target.preserved: every input BF16 bit, reconstructed F32 weight bit, current role weight layout, geometry, workgroup order/count, local128 four-wave K ownership, each scalar fmaf, wave32 shuffle tree, serial wave-0..3 sum, BF16/F32 store, raw-Q5 producer, and all fallback behavior
